speed.title: Blazing Fast
speed.text: Most features run locally with caching — minimal network overhead. Open a new tab and it loads instantly.

favorites.title: Your Favorites, Always in View
favorites.text: See your most-visited sites at a glance. Add your own shortcuts and start every browsing session with ease.

themes.title: More Than One Look
themes.text: Customize the layout and visual style to your liking — seamlessly fitting into your browsing routine.

monet.title: An Interface That Breathes
monet.text: Monet-inspired dynamic color extraction from your wallpaper{sup1}. A fresh ambiance with every open{sup2}.
monet.note1: Note 1: Not supported for video wallpapers or solid-color backgrounds
monet.note2: Note 2: Theme color only updates on open when using an online API with a rotating wallpaper

i18n.title: Built for Multiple Languages
i18n.text: Supports Simplified Chinese · Traditional Chinese (HK/TW) · English{br}Localized for regional conventions, not machine translation
